name: Boy George - Live DJ Set & Culture Talk (Patong / Phuket)
original_name: Boy George - Live DJ Set & Culture Talk (Patong / Phuket)
overview: An exclusive archive interview with pop icon and DJ Boy George, recorded live during his DJ set at the Seduction Nightclub in Patong, Phuket. In this candid cultural talk, he dives deep into music production, sharing insights on legendary dub producer Adrian Sherwood, his connection to fashion icon Vivienne Westwood, and the evolution of global club culture.
